required.name: search_knowledge
required.when_to_use: Fetch the refund policy chunk before any eligibility statement.

required.name: get_order
required.when_to_use: Verify order, amount, and date before reasoning — never trust user-stated amounts.

required.name: process_refund
required.when_to_use: Execute the confirmed refund exactly once after explicit confirmation of amount + destination. Never retry by re-invocation — reconcile by lookup.

required.name: request_human_handoff
required.when_to_use: Ambiguous eligibility or policy exceptions — log the ambiguity and hand off, do not decide.
